# EYVA

EYVA is a seven-layer shower head — carbon, sediment and vitamin C — with two replaceable parts, EYVA Purify in the handle and EYVA Care in the head. It is for women in the UAE whose hair and skin changed after they moved here, as the step before their shampoo. It is designed in Dubai by its founder, Val, made in Korea by a manufacturer certified to ISO 9001, and delivered anywhere in the UAE. It is not on sale yet: the waitlist holds the launch price of AED 549 for 14 days from the first day of sale, and after that it is AED 599. Every EYVA comes with sixty days: if you feel no difference, send it back and we refund you in full.
